blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India operated on April 16, 1853, between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane.
Lord Dalhousie is widely recognized as the 'Father of Indian Railways'.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is currently divided into 19 administrative zones.
The longest railway platform in the world is at Shree Siddharoodha Swamiji Hubballi Junction in Karnataka.
Project Unigauge was launched in 1992 to convert narrow and meter gauge tracks to broad gauge.
